summary: Procurement request: Purchase PostHog Cloud annual seats and onboarding package for Platform Analytics
description:
Issue summary: Platform Analytics requests procurement of PostHog Cloud annual subscription (enterprise tier) to replace an ad-hoc mix of self-hosted instances and trial accounts.

Impact: Current analytics data is fragmented across two self-hosted PostHog instances and several trial accounts. This fragmentation is delaying product usage instrumentation, A/B analysis, and rollout metrics for Q2 experiments. The Platform team cannot complete two runway-critical experiments until a consolidated, managed analytics instance is available.

Business justification: Moving to PostHog Cloud reduces maintenance burden on infra, provides guaranteed SLAs for event ingestion, and gives built-in product analytics and feature flag integrations the product team needs. Centralizing on a single vendor will also simplify data governance and auditing.

Requested action: Procurement to obtain 18 standard seats + 2 admin seats on PostHog Cloud (Enterprise), 12-month contract. Add onboarding package (2 days professional services) and SOC2 evidence request for security review. Provide a cost breakdown and draft PO for Finance and Legal review.

Desired delivery date: asap but no later than 2026-04-05 to meet experiment deadlines.

Attachments/quotes: Two vendor quotes attached in Confluence page linked above (vendor_quickquote_posthog_2026-03-09.pdf).
request_details: Vendor: PostHog Cloud (posthog.com). Tier requested: Enterprise (support + enterprise features). Seat allocation: 18 standard user seats for Platform Analytics and product engineering, 2 admin seats for infra/security. Add-on: 2-day professional services for onboarding and implementation of event schema and privacy settings. Compliance request: SOC2 Type II report and data residency confirmation for eu-west. Contact at vendor: emma.smith@posthog.com, quote ID PH-2026-03-09-REDWOOD-01.
estimated_cost: $21,450 annual estimate (vendor quote: $18,500 subscription + $2,950 onboarding + taxes/fees). Final cost subject to vendor discount and procurement negotiation.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed seat gap: current active PostHog users tracked via admin console = 12; projected growth for Q2 = +6 seats.
- Confirmed self-hosted instances: prod-analytics-1 (eks), prod-analytics-2 (on-prem), and 3 developer trial accounts.
- Security flagged need for SOC2 and data residency statement (raised with Security via #security channel).
- Legal needs standard SOW + DPA; vendor indicated they can sign Redwood's DPA with minor edits.
- Finance asked to provide GL code and whether to use corporate card or PO.
